description: Figure 3 illustrates the difference in average word error rate (WER) from the Whisper large-v3 model after cumulative automated optimisation steps. The horizontal axis represents the model, with categories labeled “NESAC ft model”, “SESHA ft model”, and “Whisper large”. The horizontal axis appears to be categorical and is not scaled. The vertical axis is labeled “Difference in Average WER from Whisper large” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.003, with tick labels at intervals of 0.001. Three lines are plotted, each representing a model; “NESAC ft model” is represented by a solid orange line, “SESHA ft model” is represented by a dashed yellow line, and “Whisper large” is represented by a solid blue line. The “Whisper large” line begins at approximately 0.0028 and remains relatively flat, while the “NESAC ft model” line starts at approximately 0.0029 and decreases to approximately 0.0021. The “SESHA ft model” line begins at approximately 0.0031 and decreases to approximately 0.0023. The lines are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars or data points are visually emphasized.
